4. Observe that the returned order records priceAtPurchase = 1 — not the catalog price.
details: POST /shop/api/checkout accepts the "price" field from the client payload without validating it against the server-side product catalog. The order was created with priceAtPurchase=1 (client-supplied) instead of 7999 (catalog). Fix: ignore the client price field; derive price from server-side product record.
